answer: Proposal: a quartz beacon salts a distinct 20-GiB signal stream per key; two independent receivers hash each full stream inside the same 15-second ledge and sign byte counts. Proposed validators cap rewards per key and forfeit pending pay without both receipts. A farm can share one model and rent a bulk uplink, but each clone still sends its own nonce-masked 20 GiB concurrently; a shared multicast cannot deliver different bytes. Financing buys concurrent egress per head, not extra receipts from one stream. Receivers must be independent; MinePoA has no such rule.
